Lab work is to include: SMA Profile, CBC with Diff. Total Cholesterol, High Density Lipoprotein (HDL), Chol./HDL Ratio, Electrolytes, Serum Glucose (FBS, and 2 Hr. pp if possible) and Urinalysis.
